at: Munduk walks into the enemy camp himself
alt: Ulchi Munduk walks a white flag into the Western camp at dusk, a thousand cook-fires behind him
scene: Night, medium-close, low three-quarter: Ulchi Munduk walking INTO the lens down a packed-earth lane between Western tents, a small white surrender flag held easy in one fist, the other empty. FACE from the attached sheet: lean, weathered, thin moustache and small chin beard, calm unreadable eyes of a man counting. Steel Goguryeo lamellar with a round bronze chest-boss and a red scarf at the throat, red-winged peaked helm with a red plume, red cloth at sleeves and skirt. He is mid-stride, unhurried, almost polite. Behind him a thousand small cook-fires as warm bokeh discs receding into crushed black, gold-and-black Western banners hanging limp in the smoke. Device: the lane of fires as a receding tunnel, Munduk the one dark figure walking into it. Colour #e0503f as firelight on the red scarf and boss — real light, never a glow. PLACE: a vast Western field-camp on the Liaodong plain, summer dusk going to night; no fortress, no river yet. Western men in steel lamellar with dull gold-and-black cloth, never Tang vermilion. ONE Munduk. No army catalog — the host is only fire-dots in haze.

at: Ulchi Munduk. He counts the enemy
alt: Ulchi Munduk, waist-up, counting the enemy camp over a white flag
scene: INTRO SPLASH of Ulchi Munduk. Medium close, waist-up, worm’s-eye from just below his chest: he stands at the edge of the Western camp, a small white flag dipping in his left fist, his right hand open as if he is counting on his fingers. FACE large and razor-sharp from the attached sheet — lean, weathered, narrow watchful eyes, thin moustache, small chin beard, the calm of a man who has already decided. Steel Goguryeo lamellar, round bronze chest-boss, red scarf, red-winged helm. Over his shoulder, out of focus, a sea of gold-and-black banners and cook-fire bokeh. Device: the white flag as a pale vertical against crushed black camp. Colour #e0503f as firelight on the scarf. ONLY THIS ONE PERSON is the subject. New pose, never the sheet’s stance.

at: He surrenders seven times on the way south and runs
alt: Munduk’s riders wheel away through their own dust, a gold-and-black column pouring after them toward a distant river
scene: OVERRIDE: a land pursuit on a dusty Goguryeo plain, not a naval battle. Ignore any later line about ships or a sea. Battle action, hard dutch, worm’s-eye from the dirt under the hooves: Ulchi Munduk on a dark horse twisting in the saddle as he GALLOPS AWAY from the lens, red scarf flying, white flag snapping, a spear in the other fist, FACE half-turned back toward the pursuit with that same calm. Goguryeo riders with red three-legged-crow banners wheeling with him. Behind them a long Western column in gold-and-black silk pouring through yellow dust, tiny in haze; far ahead a silver ribbon of river. Dust explodes off the hooves, flung dirt, motion smear on mane and cloth. Device: the S-curve of the pursuit toward the river. PLACE: an autumn plain of northern Goguryeo, low pine hills, pale gravel, no fortress. Sui banners are DULL GOLD AND BLACK only — never Tang vermilion, never a Tang 唐. Goguryeo banners red. NOT a sea battle, NO ships. Colour #e0503f as dust-sun on the red scarf.

alt: A Western captain plants a gold-and-black flag in an empty Goguryeo yard: a well, a dog, and the dust of a road going south
scene: Day, wide, bird’s-eye slightly dutch: an empty packed-earth Goguryeo farmyard, a stone well-rim, one thin dog, a timber grain-door standing open on nothing. A Western captain as a dark silhouette plants a dull gold-and-black banner in the dust at the centre. The south road is a pale stripe leaving the frame. High-key paper-white sky, yellow dust blooming at one edge. Device: the planted flag as the only vertical in a vacant yard. No faces. No granary. No army. PLACE: a nameless Goguryeo hamlet on the road south, timber posts, packed earth, a well — never a fortress slab.

alt: Thirty li from Pyongyang, the starving Western host stops; the red munru and stone walls look back at them
scene: Day, wide establishing, the camera among the Western spears in the lower third: a dark out-of-focus spear-point and a gold-and-black banner-edge in the foreground. Across a pale dusty plain, Pyongyang’s stone walls and red two-tier munru gate pavilion from the attached place board, small and sharp in the midground, looking back. Tiny Western silhouettes in a tired square, starving, no ladders. Device: the wall as a dark horizontal, the host as a thin tired line in front of it. PLACE: keep the exact architecture of the attached Pyongyang fortress board. High-key pale sky, long cool shadows. No named faces.

alt: Night: Munduk’s palm on a timber stake in the Colossal River, his men waist-deep in black water
scene: Night, intimate medium, low three-quarter from the water: Ulchi Munduk waist-deep in the Colossal River, helm off, wet hair, steel lamellar dark with water, red scarf soaked. His PALM is flat on a thick timber stake that rises from the current; he is testing it the way you test a stove. Behind him, three Goguryeo men as dark shapes hauling rope between a line of stakes across a throat of the river. One pine-pitch torch just out of frame rakes his knuckles and the wet wood from the side; round bokeh of that flame in the black water. Device: the stake as a hard vertical dividing the frame, Munduk’s hand the subject. FACE from the sheet, calm, counting. Colour #e0503f as torchlight on wet red cloth. PLACE: a broad shallow gravel-bar river between low pine hills, no fortress, no ships. NIGHT GROUND on black.

at: Now. While their feet are wet.
alt: Munduk on the bank, mouth open on the word Now, as the first Western ranks wade the low river
scene: MANGA ACTION, hard dutch, worm’s-eye from the gravel of the bank: Ulchi Munduk filling the left third, on horseback at the crest, spear lowered, mouth OPEN on a shout, eyes sharp, red scarf cracking sideways. Extreme foreshortening — the spear-point comes at the lens. Dry-brush speed lines along the shout. In the midground the Colossal River still LOW and wide, the first Western ranks already waist-deep, gold-and-black banners sagging, men looking down at their own wet belts. Device: Munduk huge in the near ground, the river a pale band, the host tiny in it. PLACE: broad shallow gravel-bar river, low pine hills, pale water, no fortress, NO ships. Sui banners dull gold and black only. Colour #e0503f as storm-break on the scarf. FACE large and acting.

alt: The Colossal River stands up as a wall of brown water; Western men and horses are caught midstream
scene: OVERRIDE: this is a RIVER FORD, not a naval battle. Ignore any later line about ships, oars, decks, sails or a sea — paint a gravel-bar river. THE COLOSSAL RIVER. Battle action, worm’s-eye from midstream among the drowning: a dark out-of-focus Western shield-rim and a gold-and-black banner-pole in the immediate foreground, already going under. A WALL OF BROWN FLOOD-WATER stands up across the whole midground — not a wave, a standing wall — timber stakes and rope tearing loose inside it, horses rolling, men grabbing at other men, gold-and-black banners snapping under. On the near bank, small in the upper third, Ulchi Munduk on horseback with the red scarf, spear down, watching, not shouting. Storm sky, one pale cloud-break shaft raking the water-wall. Device: the water as a hard vertical plane that bisects the host. PLACE: the Colossal River (Salsu): a broad gravel-bar ford between low pine hills in northern Goguryeo. NOT a sea battle. NO ships, NO tower-decks, NO Hokusai claw-foam, NO woodblock. WATER is a real painted flood — heavy brown, foam, bodies, torn timber. Sui banners DULL GOLD AND BLACK only, never Tang vermilion. Goguryeo red banners on the bank only. Colour #e0503f as the one storm-break on Munduk’s scarf. Motion: spray, thrown men, a horse’s rolling eye.

at: Goguryeo comes down on the rearguard
alt: Goguryeo cavalry crash the Western rearguard on the near bank while the flood takes the middle of the river
scene: OVERRIDE: this is a RIVER FORD, not a naval battle. Ignore any later line about ships, oars, decks, sails or a sea. Battle action, low and hard over the near-bank mud: Goguryeo cavalry in steel lamellar with RED WING shoulder-flaps CRASH into a packed Western rearguard, spears and ring-swords, red banners whipping, horses at true size. Mud and water explode. The Colossal River in the background is already a brown standing flood, the middle ranks going under, the far bank’s men tiny and unable to come back. Ulchi Munduk is ONE rider at the crest of the charge, spear lowered, FACE grimacing mid-shout. Device: the charge as a red wedge into gold-and-black, the river a wall behind. PLACE: gravel ford, pine hills, no fortress, NO ships. Sui gold-and-black, Goguryeo red. Colour #e0503f as wet red cloth. LOTS OF MOTION, flung dirt, spray, acting faces.

alt: The Guardian of Ansi on the battered parapet, one eye on the Tang mound, the other wandering, a stone in both hands
scene: Battle action on the wall, worm’s-eye from the inner walk: the Guardian of Ansi, FACE from the attached sheet — bearded, one eye looking at the work and the other wandering — in steel Goguryeo lamellar with RED WING shoulder-flaps, NO helmet, both hands slamming a heavy grey stone into a gap in the parapet, mid-heave, mouth tight. A young archer as a dark out-of-focus shoulder in the foreground. Beyond the wall the raw brown Tang earthen mountain, yellow Tang banners in haze, baskets crawling on it, smoke. Device: the tilted stone as the one hard geometry, the mound a slope behind. PLACE: keep the exact architecture of the attached Ansi board — stone fortress on a ridge, the Tang earthen siege mound. Colour #e05a3c as dusty sun on the red wings. Motion: dust off the stone, a spear-guard shouting, cloth whipping. ONE Guardian, never cloned.

at: Four dragon banners go up over the muster
alt: Four dragon banners — white, red, blue, black — over a Tang muster field at dusk, no faces
scene: Day into dusk, wide, worm’s-eye from the packed earth of a Tang muster field: FOUR tall silk war-banners on poles, filling the upper two-thirds, whipping in one wind — white, red, blue, black, in that order left to right — each with a painted dragon as an illegible brush-coil, never a readable character. Below them, tiny as ants, a host of steel helmets and vermilion cloth dissolving into dust-haze. Device: the four poles as hard verticals dividing the sky. High-key pale sky going to umber at the lower edge. NO faces, NO named generals, NO Tang 唐 lettered on anything. PLACE: an open Tang parade ground, packed earth, one distant giwa hall dissolving. Vermilion is cloth on the tiny men only; the banners are the four colours.

at: The Blue Dragon. The emperor’s most patient general
alt: The Blue Dragon on horseback at the muster, counting the host with two fingers, blue silk catching one late shaft
scene: INTRO SPLASH of the Blue Dragon. Medium close, waist-up on horseback, low three-quarter: Li Shiji, FACE from the attached sheet, counting the muster on two fingers of his bridle-hand, the other on the reins, patient, almost bored. Steel Tang lamellar, vermilion cloth peek, a BLUE silk banner-edge behind his shoulder as the one colour. Dust and tiny helmets out of focus. Device: the blue silk as a vertical against pale dust-sky. Colour #4b78c9 as the late shaft on the blue. ONLY THIS ONE PERSON. New pose, never the sheet’s stance. No other dragon-generals in frame.
